# Accessibility Checklist: Self-hosted monospace font for code

**Purpose**: Validate that the accessibility requirements for the code typeface change are complete, clear, consistent and measurable (WCAG 2.2 AA, Constitution Principle X).
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Legibility of Code Text

- [x] CHK001 - Is the legibility goal (distinguishing I l 1 | and O 0) stated as a requirement on the face, with a stated way to judge it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the requirement that code size, line height and spacing stay unchanged consistent with the wider 0.6 em advance, and is the accepted consequence (more horizontal scroll, wider inline code) stated? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Plan Risks]
- [x] CHK003 - Is "an x-height close to Inter's" quantified, so the choice of face can be judged objectively? [Measurability, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK004 - Are legibility requirements defined for the system fallback stack, including Linux visitors who lack Courier New? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK005 - Are requirements stated for characters outside the shipped set (box drawing, emoji) in code, including how they fall back and that they remain readable? [Edge Case, Spec §Assumptions]

## Contrast and Syntax Highlighting

- [x] CHK006 - Is it explicit that text, background and syntax-highlight colours are unchanged, so existing contrast ratios carry over to both themes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the contrast requirement for bold and bold-italic code (heavier glyphs, same colours) addressed, or explicitly out of scope? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the statement that "no highlight class gains a font style or weight" testable against a defined list of highlight classes? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK009 - Are contrast requirements defined for inline code inside links, headings and emphasis, where the face changes but colours may combine differently? [Coverage, Spec §US1 Scenario 3]

## Italic and Meaning

- [x] CHK010 - Is it required that no meaning is conveyed by italic alone in code, given that comments keep today's non-italic style? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the purpose of the italic face (code inside emphasis, not restyling highlighting) written as a requirement rather than only an assumption? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK012 - Are requirements defined for how emphasis inside code is distinguished for users who cannot perceive slant (forced colours, high zoom)? [Gap]

## Font Swap Behaviour

- [x] CHK013 - Is code required to be visible during loading and on font failure, and is the fallback stack named or bounded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK014 - Is the swap's effect on layout bounded with a number (CLS below 0.1) and is it clear this applies to pages with code specifically? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK015 - Is the swap's effect on a reader's position inside a horizontally scrolled code block (scroll offset, focus) addressed? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [x] CHK016 - Are reduced-motion and flash considerations stated, confirming the swap involves no animation or transition? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK017 - Is the behaviour defined when the font fails to load at all, including that the page stays fully usable and meets AA? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-006]

## Reflow, Zoom and Text Spacing

- [x] CHK018 - Are the 320 CSS px reflow and 200% zoom requirements stated with the exception for code blocks (two-dimensional content) made explicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK019 - Is the requirement for the WCAG 1.4.12 text-spacing overrides scoped to code in the monospace face, not just to Inter? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK020 - Is "resize text" defined for code whose font-size is set in relative units, so the new face does not break scaling? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK021 - Are keyboard focus requirements for scrollable code blocks (visible, unobscured, WCAG 2.4.11) defined for both themes at the new, wider widths? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Themes and Forced Colours

- [x] CHK022 - Are requirements stated for light, dark and forced-colours modes together, with the same pass criteria for each? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK023 - Is the scope of "every page template, both widths, both themes" for the accessibility check enumerated, so SC-006 can be audited? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Elements Newly in the Code Font

- [x] CHK024 - Are requirements for `kbd` and `samp` (keys and sample output) defined beyond the font family, such as their existing contrast and boundaries? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK025 - Is the requirement that fonts apply with JavaScript off clear enough to cover assistive-technology users who disable scripts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK026 - Is it stated that the typeface change has no effect on the accessible name, text content or reading order of code (copy and paste, screen readers)? [Gap]
